name: Kingdom of Ireland
alt: Kingdom of Ireland under the English and British Crown

predecessors.name: Lordship of Ireland
predecessors.text: the Pale, the part of the Lordship still under Dublin in 1542; the Crown of Ireland Act made Henry VIII King of Ireland

predecessors.name: Kingdom of Leinster
predecessors.text: the last Leinster lands (Wexford, Carlow, Wicklow), 1603

predecessors.name: Tír Eoghain
predecessors.text: Tyrone and its neighbours, after the Flight of the Earls in 1607

successors.name: United Kingdom
successors.text: the whole island: 'the Kingdom of Ireland merged on 1 January 1801 with the Kingdom of Great Britain' (Act of Union, 31 December 1800)

ledger.x: 1542: Henry VIII becomes King of Ireland.
1543: Thomond submits.
1556: the first plantation.
ledger.cp: Gaelic Irish lordships of Laois and Offaly

ledger.x: 1583: the Desmond Rebellions end and Munster passes to the Crown.
1585: Airgialla ends.
1585: the Composition of Connacht.
ledger.cp: Gaelic lordships of Connacht (the Composition of Connacht)

ledger.x: 1593: the Nine Years' War begins in Ulster.
1596: the Kingdom of Desmond ends.
1603: the whole island under the Crown.
ledger.cp: Gaelic Irish lordships (Tyrone's confederacy and the rest)

ledger.x: 1603: the Kavanagh kingdom of Leinster ends.
1603: Tyrone submits.
1607: Tir Eoghain ends.
1642: the Confederation of Kilkenny takes most of the island.
1653: Ireland is annexed by the Commonwealth.
1660: the Commonwealth ends and Ireland returns to a Stuart king.
1689: James II lands at Kinsale.
1691: the Treaty of Limerick ends the war.
1707: Ireland becomes a dependency of Great Britain.
1800: the dependency ends with the Act of Union (31 December 1800); the kingdom merges with Great Britain on 1 January 1801 into the United Kingdom (see the dissolve below).
1800: the Act of Union.

wars.name: Desmond Rebellions
wars.outcome: Crown victory; the Desmond estates were confiscated and Munster was planted with English settlers.

wars.name: Nine Years' War (Ireland)
wars.outcome: Crown victory: Tyrone submitted in 1603 and the Crown held the whole island; the Flight of the Earls followed in 1607.

wars.name: Irish Confederate Wars
wars.outcome: 23 October 1641 to 27 April 1653: the Confederates held most of the island 1642-1649; the Cromwellian conquest annexed Ireland to the Commonwealth.

wars.name: Williamite war in Ireland
wars.outcome: Williamite victory: Derry relieved 28 July 1689, the Boyne 1 July 1690, Aughrim 12 July 1691, Treaty of Limerick 3 October 1691.

certainty.note: The Crown's real authority is the Pale, then bits of Leinster and Munster; the pages draw no line.
The island's coast is the frontier; internal control is complete only as a claim.
Confederate, Covenanter, Royalist and Parliamentarian zones shifted yearly.
